sloka: नैवार्थेन न कामेन विक्रमेण न चाज्ञया ।शक्या दैवगतिर्लोके निवर्तयितुमुद्यता ।। ६.११३.२५ ।।
transliteration: naivārthena na kāmena vikrameṇa na cājñayā ।śakyā daivagatirloke nivartayitumudyatā ।। 6.113.25 ।।

translations.english: "In the world, to change the divine course of action, it is not possible with wealth, or will or by prowess or king's orders."
